label: Home PV Control
info: Standalone Home PV Control for Home Battery Control users. Controls configured PV limit entities and can optionally select the HBC strategy.

name: Home PV Control logic
Control triggers
info: PV cooldown is flow-owned and strict: every PV write starts cooldown; no PV write is allowed while active; the first evaluation after cooldown expiry may change PV immediately. Hidden-PV reveal is available only when HBC strategy control is enabled, uses a fully automatic adaptive reveal with an internal 800 W safety cap, and uses a deadband-aware allocator so small reveal steps are not lost on multi-inverter setups.

name: Build HPVC report
Write temporary HPVC report
info: Writes the complete report to a temporary file. The public report is replaced only after this write has completed.

name: Generate report requested
info: The only report-generation trigger. A generation lock blocks duplicate taps; the flow then clears report-ready, marks Generating, builds a fresh report, writes it to a temporary file, publishes it atomically, and switches to View report.

name: Dashboard and diagnostics
info: Dashboard, strategy, HBC and Insight outputs.

name: On-demand report generation
info: Generate → mark generating → build → write temporary file → atomic rename → mark ready → clear generating. The Generating tile stays visible until the finished report is safely available.

name: Catch report generation errors
info: Catches build, file, publish, and Home Assistant report-state failures so the temporary file, lock, Ready state, and Generating state are always cleaned up.

name: Notify report generation failure
data: {"notification_id":"hpvc_report_error","title":"HPVC report generation failed","message":"The report could not be written. Check the Node-RED log and verify that /homeassistant/www/hpvc is writable."}

name: Publish HPVC report atomically
info: Atomically renames the completed temporary report over the public report, preventing browsers from loading partially written HTML.

name: Normalize publish exit code
Remove temporary report
info: Removes a leftover temporary report after a generation or publish failure.

name: Prevent overlapping report generation
info: Drops duplicate Generate report presses while a generation is active. A two-minute stale-lock timeout prevents a failed or restarted flow from remaining blocked.

name: Release report generation lock
info: Releases the generation lock only after the ready/generating Home Assistant states have been updated successfully.

name: Release failed report lock
info: Releases the generation lock before resetting report state after any generation or publication failure.
